steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. A request needs a criticality, a quantity with a basis, and a lead time with a source.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 2 requests need a criticality or a source

findings.title: Request with no criticality
findings.fix: Set the criticality from the asset register

findings.title: Lead time with no source
findings.fix: Name the source of the lead time

findings.title: Quantity with no basis
findings.fix: State the basis for the quantity

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] req-motor.md:12  Request with no criticality.
       Fix: Set the criticality from the asset register.
[medium] req-belt.md:19  Lead time with no source.
       Fix: Name the source of the lead time.
[low] req-pump-seal.md:26  Quantity with no basis.

Not checked: Supplier availability.
pros: Checks a request with no criticality, a quantity with no basis, and a lead time with no source.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ind-spares-requisition skill on the records for this review.
